title: Attio pinned quote
description: A white framed stage with a faint 12px dot grid that pins under the header for half a screen of scrolling while a big centred serif quote inks in word by word, pale grey to full black; the speaker's name and role sit small underneath.
notes: the serif comes from the theme's --attio-serif, falling back to the display face
the wrapper is 1.5 window heights; the stage is one window minus a 100px / 116px header
CSS only; without scroll timelines (or with reduced motion) the quote is simply dark
